## Changes since 9.3.0-dzbarsky22

- Compact frozen dictionaries and sets retained in Starlark providers using upstream `CompactImmutableDict` and `Compactable`, including the prerequisite dictionary representation changes.
- Reduce provider-map and rule memory usage with singleton `ImmutableSharedKeyMap` storage, shared empty attribute arrays, and compact `StarlarkComputedDefault` representations.
- Share Starlark string literals, identifiers, function global-name lists, and build-setting keys.
- Reduce allocations in `AggregatedSpawnMetrics`, avoid retaining C++ header-list hash tables, and compute tree-artifact relative paths on demand.
- Allocate `SkyFunctionEnvironment` collections lazily and omit package-less subdirectories from package collection values.
- Fix an `ijar` ZIP-entry allocation leak.

The [backport record](https://github.com/dzbarsky/bazel/blob/f01c4f4b9c8b2a1e37fd60a9b6cc2877c2a9d3c0/.github/backports/2026-09-11-memory.md) lists all 17 upstream commits and the 9.3 compatibility adaptations. No combined memory or performance benchmark was run for this release.

### Validation

All 22 targeted suites passed on Linux x86_64 with remote execution, covering Starlark evaluation and syntax, providers and serialization, rule attributes, build-setting transitions, Skyframe, action execution, C++ headers, `ijar`, ZIP handling, and the native test wrapper.

### Release publication

This release is immutable and includes Linux and macOS binaries for x86_64 and arm64, with SHA-256 checksums and build-provenance attestations.
